summary.text: Andrew Eberly is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Karilyn Brown; he ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Eberly ran in the 2024 general election for Arkansas House District 67 and lost to incumbent Karilyn Brown, 47.8 percent to 52.2 percent.
